periods.analysis: We hosted or supported 14 social connection events in Q1, most of them indoors at library branches.
periods.recommendations: Add outdoor spring events in Riverside and Bayshore.

periods.analysis: Events rose from 14 in Q1 to 19 in Q2 as spring porch socials began in Riverside.
periods.recommendations: Build a summer calendar of park gatherings.

periods.analysis: Events and programs grew from 14 in Q1 to 19 in Q2 and 26 in Q3. The summer calendar of porch socials and park gatherings accounts for most of the Q3 increase.
periods.recommendations: Keep a baseline calendar for winter and promote events earlier so the count does not drop in Q4.
